svg.desc: SysML requirement diagram generated from the model for a sheet of WP-S-07 §4: each detailed cybersecurity requirement with its status (in place, partly, not met, not determined; WP-S-07 Figure 4-1), its allocation and verification methods, a «deriveReqt» arrow to the concept requirement CSR-C-nn it refines, the elements that satisfy it, the safety requirements it states the same mechanism as («trace», WP-S-07 §8) and the verification cases that name it.
svg.text: V-28 · CSR requirement diagram · updates and supply chain
CSR-C-12…CSR-C-13 of WP-S-07 §4: status, parent, allocation, shared safety mechanisms and cases
The updater shall stage an update only after verifying a
LionDriver-signed release manifest (§3.6) and every artefact against it; the manifest signature uses the
firmware scheme, ECDSA over P-256 with SHA-256 (DQ-191 A), with the offline update key.
allocated SoC; ENV · verified by R, UT, PT
Release builds shall fix the update origin and accept only
release-channel branches, ignoring UpdaterTargetBranch values outside it.
The updater shall reject a manifest whose release version is lower
than the installed one unless the manifest is a signed rollback release.
allocated SoC; ENV · verified by UT
Until CSR-121 is implemented, DisableUpdates shall be set in the
reference configuration and updates installed manually per WP-O-02 UPD-02.
Update installation shall be offroad-only and atomic, with the
previous release remaining bootable if finalization fails.
allocated SoC · verified by R, HIL
The update-signing key shall be distinct from the panda release
key, held offline, and covered by a re-keying procedure.
All submodules shall point to LionDriver-controlled forks and be
No release dependency or tool shall be resolved from a mutable
allocated ENV · verified by CM, BA
Every release shall have an SBOM covering uv.lock packages,
submodule commits, LFS artefacts, AGNOS version and images, comma-deps wheels and the panda
Every release and the current release weekly shall be scanned
against public vulnerability data, with each finding assessed before release.
Release signing material shall never be available to CI jobs
triggered from pull requests or forks.
allocated ENV · verified by CM, R
